protocol.description: Intents-based cross-chain bridge using optimistic verification via UMA's Optimistic Oracle V3 (OOV3). Hub-and-spoke architecture: HubPool on Ethereum L1 holds LP liquidity; SpokePools on each supported chain handle deposits and fills. Relayers front funds; OOV3 settles bundle disputes. v4 adds ZK-proof settlement via Succinct SP1. Supports 24+ chains.
